 Packer/Cowboy Fan Misconduct Results in Numerous Arrests
 Oct 19, 2026 | 7:30 AM 
 Local News , Ryan Brahm 
 While the game on the field got a bit chippy, the fans in the stands at Lambeau Field followed suit.
 The Green Bay Police Department was called 29 times for service as the Packers took on the Cowboys, the most so far this season.
 During those calls, six people were arrested, the most since the November 18 th game against the Titans in 2022, and two-thirds of the total arrests in all of 2025.
 Also, 16 people were ejected, more than any game over the past five seasons.
